site_program: Parkland Health and Hospital System, Dallas
screening_population: stable inborn newborn-nursery infants >=35 weeks and >=2100 g; suspected CCHD, NICU admission, respiratory distress or cyanosis before 4 h excluded
screening_timing_raw: 4 h after birth; infants <96% rescreened at discharge
screening_algorithm_raw: postductal SpO2; <96% at 4 h triggered discharge rescreen; persistent <96% triggered echocardiography
diagnosis_categories_raw: persistently low SpO2 with normal echocardiogram; alternative diagnosis not reported
individual_diagnoses: one infant persistently <96% at discharge; echocardiography normal; no alternative diagnosis reported
management_actionability_evidence: Echocardiography is diagnostic ascertainment only. No treatment, escalation, disposition change, follow-up consequence, or noncardiac diagnosis was reported.
poolability_reason: exact denominator but the sole harmonized-CCHD-negative final failed screen has no terminal noncardiac clinical classification; ascertainment below 90%
source_full_text_provenance: Primary: Sendelbach DM et al. Pediatrics. 2008;122(4):e815-e820. PMID 18762486; DOI 10.1542/peds.2008-0781.
extraction_notes: 859 infants were abnormal at the initial 4-h screen, but 767/768 rescreened infants normalized; only one persistent failed screen belongs in the locked denominator. Normal echo is not recoded as healthy.

site_program: Catholic University of the Sacred Heart, Rome newborn nursery
screening_population: 5750 asymptomatic low-risk nursery newborns with negative prenatal structural-heart assessment
screening_algorithm_raw: clinical cardiovascular examination plus pulse oximetry; positive pulse-oximetry infants underwent echocardiography
study_target_definition_raw: congenital heart disease screening in low-risk newborns
diagnosis_categories_raw: PFO; structurally normal echocardiogram without alternative noncardiac diagnosis
individual_diagnoses: PFO x2; one structurally normal echocardiogram
management_actionability_evidence: No qualifying management consequence is reported. PFO x2 are NON_CAN under the locked transitional/incidental lesion rule. The third infant is echo-normal but has no noncardiac clinical outcome and remains UNKNOWN.
poolability_reason: terminal clinical ascertainment is 2/3, below the >=90% principal threshold
source_full_text_provenance: Primary: Zuppa AA et al. J Matern Fetal Neonatal Med. 2015;28(1):7-11. PMID 24588079; DOI 10.3109/14767058.2014.899573.
extraction_notes: Strict 0/3; Expanded 0/3; NON_CAN2; UNKNOWN1. A prior secondary interpretation suggesting PPHN in these false positives is rejected because it is not supported by the primary report.

site_program: Hospital Materno Infantil Jose Domingo de Obaldia
screening_population: apparently healthy asymptomatic newborns; clinically evident CHD, pneumonia, sepsis, pulmonary hypertension and supplemental oxygen in first 24 h excluded
screening_timing_raw: source eligibility describes 24-48 h, but results report 86.6% screened within first 24 h and 13.4% before 48 h
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal SpO2; positive <95% or pre/postductal difference >3%; repeat testing 1-2 h later for borderline results; persistent abnormalities underwent echocardiography
study_target_definition_raw: congenital heart disease screening; one complex right-heart lesion considered critical by authors
diagnosis_categories_raw: PDA with hemodynamic repercussion; anomalous pulmonary venous connections; structurally normal echo; complex right-heart lesion
diagnosis_counts_raw: PDA with hemodynamic repercussion 6; anomalous pulmonary venous connections 3; structurally normal echo 6; complex right-heart lesion 1
individual_diagnoses: PDA x6; anomalous pulmonary venous connections x3; normal cardiac structure x6; hypoplastic RV + hypoplastic tricuspid valve + pulmonary atresia versus critical domed pulmonary stenosis + large tortuous PDA + suspected ventriculo-coronary fistulas x1
lesion_mapping_status: If the complex lesion is PA/IVS it is unconditional harmonized CCHD and denominator=15. If it is critical pulmonary stenosis, the source does not document the locked <=28-day death/surgery/catheterization event, so it remains harmonized-CCHD-negative and denominator=16. The three anomalous pulmonary venous connections are not specified as total and lack qualifying <=28-day outcome evidence, so they remain in the denominator.
management_actionability_evidence: Two of six hemodynamically significant PDA cases required medical closure -> CAN-A2. The remaining four PDA cases had reported hemodynamic repercussion but no qualifying management consequence -> CAN-U4. Three anomalous pulmonary venous connections -> CAN-U3. If the complex right-heart lesion remains in denominator -> CAN-U1. Six structurally normal echoes remain UNKNOWN because noncardiac causes were not ascertained.
entry_hold_reason: inherited lesion-target mapping gate; complex lesion differential PA/IVS versus critical pulmonary stenosis
poolability_reason: harmonized denominator is bounded 15-16 and terminal clinical ascertainment is only 60.0%-62.5%; no point weight is assigned
source_full_text_provenance: Primary full text: Miranda Peralta AL. Pediatr Panama. 2018;47(1):13-19. DOI 10.37980/im.journal.rspp.20181608.
extraction_notes: Source reports 2236 screened in the abstract but 2235 in discussion; use 2236 as primary reported total and preserve discrepancy. Strict=2 throughout; Expanded=9/15 if PA/IVS or 10/16 if critical PS remains denominator. Screening-timing statements are internally inconsistent and retained as a heterogeneity flag.

site_program: New Jersey statewide CCHD screening program
screening_population: 73,320 eligible live births; 99.1% underwent screening; program included well-baby nursery and NICU/special-care nursery locations
screening_timing_raw: before discharge according to statewide implementation protocol
screening_algorithm_raw: statewide pulse-oximetry CCHD protocol; all failed screens reported to registry with follow-up review
study_target_definition_raw: authors reported seven CCHD among 49 failed screens
diagnosis_categories_raw: author-defined CCHD; other CHD/echo findings; noncardiac diagnoses; no diagnosis
diagnosis_counts_raw: author CCHD 7; other diagnoses/findings 30; no diagnosis 12
individual_diagnoses: screen-attributable group: d-TGA, tricuspid atresia, CoA/arch hypoplasia/BAV plus 17 specified other findings and 10 no diagnosis; prior-indicator group: HLHS, IAA, TGA, TAPVR plus 13 other diagnoses/findings and 2 no diagnosis
lesion_mapping_status: Only HLHS and interrupted aortic arch are definite harmonized CCHD. d-TGA/TGA are not assumed to be simple TGA without explicit anatomy; CoA and TAPVR lack the required <=28-day invasive-intervention/death evidence; tricuspid atresia is not an automatic locked-target lesion. These five author-CCHD cases therefore remain in the harmonized-negative denominator.
management_actionability_evidence: Among the 30 infants whose diagnostic evaluation was attributable solely to the failed screen, the reclassified d-TGA, tricuspid-atresia and CoA cases were transferred out -> CAN-A3. Seven specifically described alternative diagnoses/findings in this subgroup are clinically relevant but lack qualifying management evidence -> CAN-U7; ten specified minor/resolved findings are NON_CAN10; ten had no diagnosis. In the 19 infants with prior clinical indicators, reclassified TGA and TAPVR are CAN-U2 because screening did not change already-indicated management; 13 remaining broad 'other diagnosis/finding' cases cannot be separated into CAN-U versus NON_CAN and remain UNKNOWN; two had no diagnosis.
poolability_reason: mixed WBN/NICU/SCN setting is not separable and terminal CAN classification is only 34/47 (72.3%), below the principal threshold
source_full_text_provenance: Primary full text: Garg LF et al. Pediatrics. 2013;132(2):e314-e323. PMID 23858425; PMCID PMC4471476; DOI 10.1542/peds.2013-0269.
extraction_notes: Strict 3/47; Expanded 12/47; NON_CAN10; explicit no-diagnosis12; UNKNOWN13. Do not compute an exact screened N from 73,320 eligible x 99.1%; total_screened is intentionally left blank. The five author-CCHD cases retained in denominator follow the locked target rather than source terminology.
